methodology.timeline: Timestamp-ordered captured contract premiums. Raw HHMM files win; the streamed gzip archive fills a missing raw contract-minute.
methodology.contractRows: Journal rowFor rule: card.expiry === series.next.e ? series.next.r : series.r, then strike + side.
methodology.touch: Journal cumulative day high/low is seeded from the last pre-entry row; an increment across SL and TGT1 in one sample is ambiguous. Session extremes are not used as outcomes.
methodology.stops: Scaled-stop risk is entry minus that variant stop; target R and close-exit R are renormalized to the variant risk. Breakeven uses the original risk for its arm threshold and R denominator.
methodology.winnersLost: Baseline first-touch TGT1 cards that a variant does not settle as TGT1.
methodology.range: Per-card preTargetDip is captured premium depth below entry before its first simulated terminal event.
methodology.dataLimit: Captured minutes are sampled market evidence, not exact exchange OHLC or fill confirmation. Missing samples and sessions are reported per card.
methodology.underlyingPreview: S2-only, read-only gate preview: needs.sl.level as slSpot, futures candle close breach in the card bias direction, and the −70% premium disaster backstop. This does not modify cards or journal semantics.

underlyingPreview.method: S2 measurement only; S4 is not implemented.
